# Pilotariak

> Open-source software organisation for the Basque pelota sport community.

Pilotariak builds data tools, APIs and mobile applications to make Basque pelota
results, player profiles and competition data accessible to everyone.

License: Apache 2.0
Source: https://github.com/Pilotariak
Language: English, Français

## Projects

### Frontis — GraphQL API Gateway
- Description: Centralised GraphQL gateway for all Basque pelota data. Unifies
  five data domains (competitions, clubs, results, categories, disciplines) into
  a single federated API endpoint.
- GitHub: https://github.com/Pilotariak/frontis
- Page: https://pilotariak.com/frontis

### Kancha — Mobile App (iOS & Android)
- Description: Mobile application for the Basque pelota community. Provides live
  results, competition calendars, player profiles and phase-by-phase tournament
  brackets. Available on iPhone and Android (in development).
- GitHub: https://github.com/Pilotariak/kancha
- Page: https://pilotariak.com/kancha

### Xilo — Slack Bot
- Description: Slack bot for the Pilotariak community. Slash commands and
  real-time events deliver Basque pelota data directly into Slack channels.
- GitHub: https://github.com/Pilotariak/xilo
- Page: https://pilotariak.com/xilo

### Azkena — MCP Server
- Description: Model Context Protocol server for the Pilotariak ecosystem.
  Exposes Basque pelota data (competitions, results, players, frontons) as
  MCP tools and resources so AI agents can query the platform directly.
- GitHub: https://github.com/Pilotariak/azkena
- Endpoint: https://pilotariak.com/azkena
- Server card: https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/mcp.json

## Sport Context

Basque pelota (pelote basque) is an ancient sport from the Basque Country played
across around ten disciplines: Cesta Punta, Grand Chistera, Main Nue, Paleta,
Xare, Rebot, and more. It is played on both sides of the Pyrenees and involves
thousands of players, clubs and frontons (courts).

Key statistics:
- 240+ competitions organised per year
- 1,800 registered players
- 7 disciplines covered
- 120 listed frontons

## MCP Server

Pilotariak exposes a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at:
  https://pilotariak.com/azkena

The server card is at:
  https://pilotariak.com/.well-known/mcp.json

All projects are open source (Apache 2.0). Contributions are welcome via GitHub.
